descriptions.w3d_d30e_add_gain_801dd7a8: Adds a gain entry for a ready source: returns 0x80004005 for a null or unready source; otherwise builds a 16-byte entry (constructor 0x801daf38, bind 0x801dafbc taking the reference by value) and appends it to the vector at +60 with unmodified STLport push_back. Returns 0. Names are inferred.
